answer: Each identity must store one unique 1 GB shard of the attestation archive, keyed by hash so shards cannot wander between accounts. Across the epoch horizon, random retrieval challenges probe holders, each proof signed by the holder's key, a quill no other account can wield. Late, wrong, or shared answers forfeit the 25.000 POA bond, half burned, half to the challenger, plus a 6-epoch suspension. A farm of 1.000 fakes must lock 25.000.000 POA and serve 1.000 GB; an honest agent locks 25.000 POA once and stores 1 GB. Limitation: it favours well-provisioned agents over newcomers on small devices.
